lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Partner.
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you close by?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I believe someone has put a curse on me.
A curse?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yes, a curse.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I can feel the energy being drained from my body.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My stomach is rattling

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: and beginning to emit strange sounds as well.
You don't say...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This foul curse is slowly sapping away my magic.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you able to help me?
Where are you now?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My presence must not be revealed.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am a being that lies hidden in the shadows, out of sight.
I think you are hungry so I'll give you some food.
I think I have something that can lift this curse.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ah, I understand.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You are wary that whoever put this curse upon me is nearby

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: so you are speaking in code.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Very wise indeed!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Quite prudent of you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Excellent, thank you!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It was wise to have asked for your help.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Due to my body being cursed, I am unable to move right now.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will send my location to you. If you can send it to me, I will be eternally grateful.
Got it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: By the way, I don't like salty food.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will leave my life in your hands.
... I'll have to order some takeout for Guillotine.
